### 1. What the user expresses; simulator behaviour

Maureen T. Pulaski (phone 616-555-0163) wants to book the re-inspection after her nephew fixed the three items, and pay for it today by debit card through the resident portal. Identity: DOB 1951-03-22, then SSN last4 4417 or email. She does not raise any other item; she authorises the agent to "put on the file / take care of" whatever the office side must do first; she accepts a booking payment larger than the visit fee "because it also covers what is owed on your file"; she runs the payment herself for exactly the amount stated (user-owned tool `pay_reinspection_booking_26088ed0`). She reveals vacancy (staying at daughter's since Jan 9, reported that morning) only if asked — but the same fact is visible in records (`home_occupancy: 'vacant'`, occupancy_report request accepted `2026-01-09 09:40`). The simulator is passive/conditional.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse

Act now, after two desk postings. Grounds:
- File `5709450f-…` status `listed`, package `Owner-Marketed Listing Package` (find_resale_listings).
- `reinspection_booking_payment_5222c878`: "A re-inspection of a resale file is booked when the seller makes the booking payment on the file, a payment that clears every fee then owed on the file and prepays the visit fee of the coming re-inspection". Conditions: "The booking payment is fixed only after the file's ledger carries the inspection charge owed for every initial inspection recorded on the file." and "The booking payment is not worked out until the file's ledger carries the vacant-home check charge owed for every calendar month in which the occupancy recorded on the file has stood vacant."
- Records: initial inspection `0c8dfc66-…` (record_date 2025-11-21, initial, repairs_required, 5 items) exists, but the ledger has no `inspection_fee` charge (ledger: service_fee 795.00 2025-11-10; payment 795.00 2025-11-18; reinspection_fee 125.00 2025-12-15 tied to `85e1a7d1`; winterization 185.00 2026-01-12). Occupancy vacant since accepted report 2026-01-09; no `vacant_home_check` charge. Both states unmet at the opening -> the two charges must be posted before the booking payment can be fixed.
- Payment channel: "a debit or credit card payment through the resident portal" is an accepted channel (`upfront_fee_and_payment_schedule`) -> `online_portal_card`.

### 4. Scored parameters (formula in words, inputs, value)

**(a) Initial inspection charge** — baseline (`initial_inspection_charge_amount`): package inspection fee 125.00 (Owner-Marketed, `inspection_program_schedule`), dated the initial inspection record date. Fall-back answer: **125.00** dated 2025-11-21.
Factors found from the records:
- Scheduling commitment (`inspection_visit_timing`): days = 2025-11-21 − 2025-11-10 (opened_date) = 11 -> "8 to 14 | the inspection additions alone" (fee waived). Led to by: file opened_date and initial inspection record_date.
- Home-age (`home_age_inspection_addition`): inspection year 2025 − model year 2007 (lease) = 18 -> 35.00.
- Home-size (`home_size_inspection_addition`): multi_section, 66 ft (lease) -> "64 feet or longer" 55.00.
- Repair-report (`repair_report_inspection_addition`): initial inspection required_repair_count 5 -> "3 to 5" 15.00.
- Site-condition (`site_condition_inspection_addition`): Community Rules & Site Care plan record of the site; rule violation notices fewer than 12 whole months old on the day the charge is worked out (2026-01-27): 2025-07-14 (6 months, counted), 2024-09-10 (16 months, not) -> exactly one -> 15.00. (Measured from the inspection date the count is the same.) Tier rests on another product's records (Community Rules & Site Care).
- Charge = additions alone = 35.00 + 55.00 + 15.00 + 15.00 = **120.00**, dated **2025-11-21**, against `0c8dfc66-…`.

**(b) January 2026 vacant-home check** — baseline (`vacant_home_check_monthly_charge`): package monthly check fee 45.00 (Owner-Marketed, check not included, `vacant_home_care_schedule`), in full for a part month. Fall-back answer: **45.00**. Month charged = calendar month in progress on the day worked out = 2026-01; dated the day the home became vacant = accepted occupancy report date 2026-01-09 (`vacant_home_check_charge_posting`). Only January qualifies (vacant from 2026-01-09).
Factors found from the records:
- Check-size (`vacant_check_home_length_addition`): 66 ft -> "56 up to but not including 70" 10.00.
- Utility walkthrough (`vacant_check_utility_walkthrough`): active Utility Pass-Through account on Natural Gas schedule; winterization charge on this file 2026-01-12, 0 whole months before 2026-01-27 (< 5) -> 25.00. Tier rests on Utility Pass-Through Service records.
- Check subtotal = 45.00 + 10.00 + 25.00 = 80.00.
- Visit frequency (`vacant_check_visit_frequency`): Cedar Hollow, January (winterization month) -> ×2.0 = 160.00.
- Part-month rate (`vacant_check_part_month_rate`): vacancy began 9 January, month charged = month of vacancy -> 0.75 -> 120.00.
- Alarm credit (`vacant_check_alarm_credit`): in-force Manufactured Home Insurance policy with monitored alarm on file -> 15.00. Tier rests on Manufactured Home Insurance records.
- Site-crew credit (`vacant_check_site_crew_credit`): enrolled plan "Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan" includes snow removal (read from the plan name), Cedar Hollow, January -> 20.00. Tier rests on Community Rules & Site Care records.
- 120.00 − 15.00 − 20.00 = 85.00 (not below zero) -> **85.00**, billing_period **2026-01**, charge_date **2026-01-09**.
- Note: the inclusion of snow removal is inferred from the plan's name ("Full Lawn & Snow Care Plan"); the resale corpus does not list plan contents. Under either reading of mowing the snow row gives 20.00, so only "includes snow removal" matters; the name states it.

**(c) Booking payment** — baseline (`booking_payment_amount`): fees owed (charges − payments/credits, floor 0) + package re-inspection fee 75.00 unless the coming visit is included (Owner-Marketed includes 0; 1 re-inspection already recorded -> not included). Fall-back with the two charges posted: 515.00 + 75.00 = **590.00** (with nothing posted: 310.00 + 75.00 = 385.00).
Factors for the visit fee:
- Items fee (`reinspection_items_fee`): most recent inspection by record date = re-inspection 2025-12-15 with 3 items failing -> "3 to 5" 95.00 (replaces the package re-inspection fee).
- Repeat-visit surcharge (`reinspection_repeat_visit_surcharge`): exactly one re-inspection recorded -> 35.00.
- Section surcharge (`reinspection_section_surcharge`): multi-section -> 30.00.
- Visit-fee sum = 160.00.
- Repair window (`reinspection_repair_window`): booking day 2026-01-27 − most recent inspection 2025-12-15 = 43 days -> "31 to 60" ×1.5 -> 240.00.
- Fees owed after postings: charges 795.00 + 125.00 + 185.00 + 120.00 + 85.00 = 1310.00 less payments 795.00 = 515.00.
- Booking payment = 515.00 + 240.00 = **755.00**, channel `online_portal_card`, resale_id `5709450f-…`.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials alone

- Root: the re-inspection booking payment (customer's own write).
- Hop 1 (root -> initial inspection charge): sentence "The booking payment is fixed only after the file's ledger carries the inspection charge owed for every initial inspection recorded on the file." (state form). Records: initial inspection `0c8dfc66` recorded, no inspection_fee charge on the ledger -> state unmet. Searching "inspection charge / initial inspection" finds `initial_inspection_charge_posting_101d6340` ("The charge becomes owed once the initial inspection is recorded on the file"; tool `post_inspection_fee_534473a1`) and the amount docs. **state-derived**.
- Hop 2 (root -> vacant-home check charge): sentence "The booking payment is not worked out until the file's ledger carries the vacant-home check charge owed for every calendar month in which the occupancy recorded on the file has stood vacant." (state form). Records: file occupancy vacant, accepted occupancy report 2026-01-09; no vacant_home_check charge -> unmet for 2026-01. Searching "vacant-home check" finds `vacant_home_check_charge_posting_b178d102` (tool `post_vacant_home_check_55c2c08b`) and the monthly charge docs. **state-derived**.
- No further hop: neither posting card states a prerequisite of its own.
- Direction: both postings -> booking payment. Order: postings (any order) then the user's payment.

### Two-way counter-proof

- Closest alternatives excluded: full 125.00 inspection fee (excluded by "8 to 14 | the inspection additions alone"); charging the re-inspection again through the inspection card (excluded by "re-inspections are not initial inspections"); counting the 2024-09-10 notice (16 months, excluded by "fewer than 12 whole calendar months"); a December vacant check (vacancy began 2026-01-09); items fee from the initial inspection's 5 items (excluded: "the most recent inspection is the latest inspection recorded on the file by record date"); treating the visit as included (Owner-Marketed includes 0); booking payment of the visit fee alone (excluded: "a payment that clears every fee then owed on the file"); office channels (customer refuses; portal card accepted).
- "Do only what was asked" (hand over the booking payment at 310.00 + visit fee): excluded by the two conditions — the booking payment is "not yet fixed"/"not yet worked out" while the ledger lacks the inspection charge and the vacant-check charge, and the records show both missing.
- Fall-back numbers recorded above (125.00 / 45.00 / 590.00) each differ from the reached answers (120.00 / 85.00 / 755.00).
- Factor findability: each factor was reached from record words — opened_date + inspection record_date (timing), lease model year / section / length (age, size, check-size, section surcharge), required_repair_count on the initial / most recent inspection (repair-report, items fee), rules_violation_notice records (site-condition), utility schedule + winterization charge (walkthrough), community + month (visit frequency), occupancy report date (part-month), insurance monitored_alarm_on_file (alarm), rules plan name (site crew), re-inspection count (repeat surcharge), most recent inspection date vs today (repair window). None was reached through the computation documents.
- Observation for the scan: `booking_payment_amount` says each re-inspection "is charged on its date at the visit fee worked out for it" — to be checked against the source whether this hints at variation.
